title: MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - PRICE) relative to coordinating a street banner campaign to promote the DineLA and encourage participation.
text:
[Council File 26-1443]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - PRICE) relative to coordinating a street banner campaign to promote the DineLA and encourage participation.
Recommendations for Council action:
APPROVE, in accordance with Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Section 62.132, the Street Banner program promoting the DineLA and encouraging participation, as a City of Los Angeles Non-Event Street Banner Program for the period of January 15, 2027 - January 29, 2027.
APPROVE the content of the street banner design attached to the Motion.
summary: Approves a non-event street banner campaign promoting DineLA and encouraging restaurant participation, with banners up January 15 to 29, 2027, and approves the banner design.

details.action: approval of non-event street banner program

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026); Council action final
